# HeyLead

> MCP-native autonomous LinkedIn SDR — AI-powered lead generation, voice-matched cold outreach, multi-touch drip sequences, and campaign analytics inside Cursor, Claude Code, or any MCP client.

HeyLead gives AI agents 35 tools covering the full SDR workflow: prospect discovery, ICP generation with buyer personas, personalized connection invitations, follow-up DMs, engagement warm-ups (comments, likes, follows, endorsements), reply handling with sentiment classification, outcome tracking, and 24/7 autonomous scheduling.

Install: Claude Code `claude mcp add heylead -- uvx heylead` · Cursor: add an MCP server with command `uvx heylead`

Work from your AI chat or from the web dashboard at https://heylead.dev/dashboard — both run the same campaigns.
